caption: Genuinely everytime I create and then don’t put it out I feel my soul constricting. And everytime I post I feel that pressure release.
author: Sebastian Scales
transcript: I'm just constantly forgetting I'm safe, over and over and over again. Every time I worry about what somebody thinks about me, I'm forgetting that I'm safe in whatever it is that they think. I keep casting my infinitely valuable mental energy and attention onto what people might be thinking about me negatively. Just out of habit, there's so much momentum behind doing this constantly with basically whoever I happen to interact with. Every text I send gets run through some sort of scanning system for potential ways it could be misinterpreted and the person who I'm texting, whoever it happens to be, might not like me anymore. But it's not unsafe for people to change their minds about you. It's not unsafe for people to not like you anymore. You're so loved by so many people and you keep shutting down your creativity because of what the people who don't love you think. All the people that will discover you from you being yourself can't discover you until you put yourself out there. So what the fuck are you waiting for? You're not doing it in the name of what are people who don't like you gonna think or are the people that do like you, are they gonna then not like you because of what you put out there? It's like, dude, none of this is your responsibility. Your only responsibility is putting yourself out there and not not putting yourself out there out of fear. What are people gonna think? You know how much shit people have thought about you from every video you've ever posted, realistically? And you're safe? Stopped acting like the act of pressing post on any app is dangerous. It doesn't matter if nobody likes it. It doesn't matter if nobody comments. It doesn't matter if people only comment how much you suck and are weird. None of that, all of that is fine. And when you're creating at a frequency in line with your authenticity, consistently creating, you can't even remember. You're not watching one video, posting one video a month and monitoring it to see how it does. Dude, the freedom is in the frequency. The freedom is in the frequency of posting. Imagine just fucking constantly letting it rip. Letting it rip to the point where you can't even remember. You can't even dwell on the videos that underperformed because you're on to the next one, dude, every day, every day. It's not like you don't have the energy to create every day. What are you waiting for? There's never gonna come a time when you can enjoy yourself There's never gonna come a time when you can ensure that you won't be judged. And you've already been judged more than you can even know. And you've been safe in all of it. People judging for shit that you haven't even considered. You have a video like this, you know you want it to come out. Don't, don't, don't just sit on this shit, man. Hey, you from the future, now, don't just keep recording shit, feeling good about it and then not putting it out. You're safe in putting it out. You're safe in whatever you put out.
title: You're Safe — Just Post It
one_liner: Stop letting fear of judgment suppress your creativity; you're already safe no matter what people think.
key_points: Constantly scanning for others' negative reactions wastes precious mental energy and is just a habit, not a real threat
It's not unsafe for people to dislike you or change their minds about you — you've survived all judgment so far
The freedom is in posting frequency: create so often you can't dwell on what underperformed
People who will love the real you can't find you until you actually put yourself out there
